notes.title: Patch Notes for The Stalked (1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Before I get into the changes, I just wanted to thank you all so much for the love and support! It really means the world to me :)

-Fixed a bug that occured at the last chase scene.
-Fixed a bug with the peephole.
-Removed the cosmetic key (it was just a stupid idea in the first place).
-Added some clarification on how to continue in the 911 call.
